# HubSpot SR Claude Toolkit — Knowledge index (LightRAG source)

**Origin:** Repository `hubspot-sr-claude-skills` (Hermitcrabs AI-First Agency). This is a **Claude Code toolkit** (`.claude/` + `docs/`), not the full SR PRO theme binary tree.

**Chunks in this folder:**
- `01-claude-global-contract.md` — `.claude/CLAUDE.md` rules
- `02-hubspot-expert-skill.md` — `hubspot-expert` SKILL
- `03-sr-expert-skill.md` — `sr-expert` SKILL (macros, skeleton, workflow)
- `04-agents-and-commands.md` — sub-agents + slash commands
- `05-docs-inventory.md` — `docs/` file map
- `06-common-mistakes-index.md` — all mistake categories (titles + one-liners)
- `07-sr-theme-guidelines-core.md` — SR wrapper, `{{ name }}`, macro list
- `08-sr-modules-selection-cheatsheet.md` — Figma→SR mapping cheatsheet + hero table start

**Relationship:** `hubspot-expert` stacks under global CLAUDE.md; `sr-expert` stacks on top for SR work.
